chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Zarif ibn Nasih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not intermingle and do not have dealings except with those who have grown up in goodness.
ai.seo_question: Who should one associate with and do business with according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the principle of 'al-mu'asharah bi-al-khayr' (socializing with goodness), highlighting that early upbringing serves as a reliable predictor of moral consistency in social and commercial dealings. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on selecting companions based on their inherent disposition (fitrah) and environmental influences, ensuring that interactions foster spiritual and ethical growth rather than corruption.
